title: Leaderboard is now an opt-in extension
notes: The top-contributors leaderboard moved out of core into a free, opt-in Marketplace extension, so communities that don't want it aren't carrying it. Install the Leaderboard extension from the Marketplace to keep it (and its header link).

changelog.text: The top-contributors leaderboard is now a free opt-in Marketplace extension instead of a built-in page.
